6.96 rsInvalidParameterNameLength
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidParameterNameLength is a critical error that will occur when a Subreport contains a
Parameters.Parameter element that has a Name attribute whose value is empty or is longer than
256 characters.
